statement: Raise DevRelay from strong deterministic traceability with mostly contract-defined ecosystem bindings to a best-in-class, live-attested, provider-neutral engineering runtime for ChatGPT Desktop on Windows.
objectives: Make RequirementsGathering use adaptive breadth-first interview waves with mandatory deterministic closure and at least 0.99 weighted coverage.
Provide a native composite requirements strategy plus bounded optional Spec Kit, BMAD, GSD, Superpowers, and OpenSpec strategy adapters.
Produce live provider attestations for OpenSpec, Spec Kit, current Structurizr tooling, MADR format conformance, Godot AI, and GdUnit4.
Add an optional Godot engineering pack with explicit grants, structured test evidence, screenshots, input receipts, export verification, and version-pinned compatibility claims.
Add automatic raw execution receipts, local performance telemetry, two-phase Git sealing, compact traceability MCP queries, and four repository-scoped ChatGPT Desktop skills.
Prove the complete result from a clean GitHub checkout through a small end-to-end Godot change on ChatGPT Desktop for Windows.
constraints: Generic Core and semantic Module contracts remain provider-neutral and domain-neutral.
Adapters never own routing, closure, approval, graph mutation, or lifecycle progression.
Provider versions and downloads are checksum-pinned, project-local, explicit, and never silently upgraded or substituted.
Execution is local and offline by default; network access and source transmission require explicit grants.
Live maturity claims require exact provider receipts and tested compatibility; fixtures remain fixture-conformant only.
ChatGPT Desktop on Windows is the release-defining product host.
acceptanceCriteria: Every blocking requirements decision is closed and weighted decision-domain coverage is at least 0.99 before RequirementsGate progression.
Priority specification, architecture, Godot, and testing providers execute live through bounded adapters with exact version, input, output, permission, and receipt evidence.
Godot support claims are limited to a version-pinned compatibility matrix exercised by conformance and end-to-end tests.
Raw receipts, performance metrics, traceability queries, and two-phase Git sealing remain deterministic, privacy-bounded, and authority-safe.
A clean GitHub checkout completes the full DevRelay circuit for a small Godot change from ChatGPT Desktop on Windows using all four repository skills.
assumptions: The owner approved every recommendation in clarification wave 2 except the withdrawn project-specific compatibility assumption, then approved the provider-matrix replacement.
Sentry and PostHog remain disabled, uninstalled, and outside V0.11.
BMAD, GSD, and Superpowers receive adapter evaluations but live maturity is claimed only where a bounded deterministic operation exists.
No upstream provider is installed until its adapter evaluation and first-download approval are complete.
